name: Quantum Server X1
short_desc: High-performance enterprise server for intensive workloads.
long_desc: The Quantum Server X1 delivers unparalleled processing power for large-scale enterprise applications, featuring multi-layered security, automated thermal management, and ultra-fast NVMe storage arrays. Perfect for data centers.

name: CloudSync Pro Software
long_desc: Seamlessly manage and sync your business data across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with military-grade encryption, zero downtime, and AI-driven conflict resolution.

name: CyberShield Firewall
short_desc: Next-gen hardware firewall with AI threat detection.
long_desc: Protect your internal network with our AI-driven threat detection firewall. It blocks zero-day exploits, phishing attempts, and DDoS attacks instantly before they reach your core network.

name: Nexus Core Switch
long_desc: High-density switching solution designed for modern data centers. Features advanced Layer 3 routing protocols, extremely low latency, and hot-swappable redundant power supplies.

name: OpticFiber Link Station
long_desc: Ensure maximum bandwidth across long distances. This terminal handles multiplexing of up to 40 channels over a single fiber pair, guaranteeing unthrottled communication between campuses.

name: Aegis Data Vault
short_desc: Immutable backup appliance for ransomware protection.
long_desc: Safeguard your most critical data with an air-gapped, immutable storage vault. Once data is written, it cannot be altered or deleted by malware, ensuring 100% recovery rates.
